<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Jobs\ProcessPaymentJob;
use App\Integrations\GoHighLevel;

class PaymentProcessor
{
    public function processTransaction(Payment $payment): Payment
    {
        // Encrypted middleware layer — sensitive data
        // never touches the application layer directly
        $encrypted = $this->encryptPayload($payment->data);

        // Dispatch to Redis queue — non-blocking
        ProcessPaymentJob::dispatch(
            $encrypted,
            $payment->gateway_id
        )->onQueue('payments');

        return $payment->markAsPending();
    }

    public function syncWithCRM(PaymentResult $result): void
    {
        // Bi-directional GoHighLevel webhook sync
        GoHighLevel::contact($result->customer_id)
            ->updateOpportunity([
                'stage'  => 'Won',
                'amount' => $result->amount,
            ]);
    }
}

    public function index(ServiceRequest $request): JsonResponse

            ->forCategory($request->category_id)
            ->withinRadius($request->lat, $request->lng, 25)
            ->cache(ttl: 30) // 30-second Redis cache
            ->paginate(20);

            ->response()
            ->setStatusCode(200);
    }
}

namespace App\Jobs;

use App\Models\Video;
use App\Services\FFmpegService;
use App\Services\CDNService;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;

class ProcessVideoJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 3;
    public int $timeout = 600; // 10 min max

    public function handle(
        FFmpegService $ffmpeg,
        CDNService $cdn
    ): void {
        // Transcode to multiple resolutions
        $outputs = $ffmpeg->transcode($this->video->raw_path, [
            '1080p' => ['bitrate' => '5000k'],
            '720p'  => ['bitrate' => '2500k'],
            '480p'  => ['bitrate' => '1000k'],
        ]);

        // Push to CDN — update manifest
        $cdn->upload($outputs)
            ->invalidateCache($this->video->cdn_key);

        $this->video->markAsReady();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class ProductCatalogService
{
    /**
     * Faceted product search with category-level caching
     * Eliminated N+1 queries — 30% faster page loads
     */
    public function search(SearchFilters $filters): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $cacheKey = 'catalog:' . md5(serialize($filters));

        return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 300, function () use ($filters) {
            return Product::query()
                ->with(['category', 'images', 'inventory'])
                ->when($filters->category, fn($q, $cat) =>
                    $q->whereHas('category', fn($q) =>
                        $q->where('slug', $cat)
                    )
                )
                ->when($filters->priceMin, fn($q, $min) =>
                    $q->where('price', '>=', $min)
                )
                ->orderBy($filters->sortBy, $filters->sortDir)
                ->paginate(24);
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\ChildProfile;
use App\Models\SchoolCalendar;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class SchoolMenuOrderService
{
    /**
     * Orderable days for a child’s weekly plan — excludes holidays
     * and respects allergy constraints from the parent profile.
     */
    public function orderableDays(ChildProfile $child, Carbon $weekStart): array
    {
        $holidays = SchoolCalendar::nonSchoolDays(
            $child->school_id,
            $weekStart
        );

        return $child->weeklyMenuPlan()
            ->forWeekStarting($weekStart)
            ->excludingDates($holidays)
            ->matchingDietaryRules($child->allergies)
            ->toSelectableSlots();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Webhooks;

use App\Jobs\FinalizeCellularPaymentJob;
use App\Models\PaymentIntent;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Response;

class PaymentWebhookController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Idempotent provider callback — verify signature, enqueue settle work.
     * Duplicate or out-of-order events must not double-capture.
     */
    public function __invoke(Request $request): Response
    {
        if (! $this->gateway->verifySignature($request)) {
            return response('invalid signature', 400);
        }

        $intent = PaymentIntent::where('provider_ref', $request->input('id'))->first();
        if (! $intent || $intent->isTerminal()) {
            return response('ok', 200); // idempotent noop
        }

        FinalizeCellularPaymentJob::dispatch($intent, $request->all())
            ->onQueue('payments-webhooks');

        return response('ok', 200);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Data\TopUpDraft;
use App\Models\Carrier;
use App\Models\TopUpIntent;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class TopUpIntentService
{
    /**
     * Four-step flow: capture MSISDN + carrier + amount, persist intent
     * before redirecting to PCI-scoped payment gateway.
     */
    public function start(TopUpDraft $draft): TopUpIntent
    {
        $carrier = Carrier::where('slug', $draft->carrierSlug)->firstOrFail();

        return TopUpIntent::create([
            'public_ref'       => (string) Str::ulid(),
            'e164'             => $draft->normalizedE164(),
            'carrier_id'       => $carrier->id,
            'amount_cents'     => $draft->amountCents,
            'status'           => 'awaiting_payment',
            'idempotency_key'  => $draft->clientIdempotencyKey(),
        ]);
    }
}

            ->with(['seller.profile', 'category'])
            ->withAvg('reviews as rating_avg', 'score')
            ->withCount('reviews')
            ->orderByDesc('is_featured')
            ->orderByDesc('rating_avg')
            ->limit(24);
    }
}
